features.rule: stringify!(balanced token trees) preserves token spelling separated by one ASCII space; no expansion of input macros.
concat!(zero or more comma-separated unsuffixed string literals; optional trailing comma) concatenates decoded strings. Other literal classes excluded.
line!() returns the one-based original call-site line as u32; arguments forbidden.
column!() returns one-based original call-site Unicode scalar column as u32; arguments forbidden.
file!() returns the supplied workspace-relative slash-normalized source-map path; no host absolute paths or filesystem access.
ident matches one non-keyword ASCII identifier [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* except lone underscore; raw identifiers and special keywords excluded.
literal matches one unsuffixed nonnegative decimal integer token or one cooked UTF-8 string literal; signs, chars, bytes, raw strings and suffixes excluded.
tt matches one non-delimiter token or one recursively balanced (), [] or {} group; unmatched delimiters reject before matching.
$( $x:ident )* matches zero, one or many adjacent identifiers; transcriber repeats at identical capture depth.
$( $x:ident )+ requires one or many adjacent identifiers; an empty invocation rejects.
$( $x:ident )? matches zero or one identifier; separator on optional and multiple captures reject.
$( $x:ident ),* matches comma-separated zero, one or many identifiers; trailing comma is excluded unless a separate optional comma is declared.
$( $x:ident ),+ matches comma-separated one or many identifiers; empty and trailing comma reject.
$( [ $( $x:ident ),* ] );* matches zero or more bracketed comma lists separated by semicolon; substitutions preserve both nesting depths and lengths.
Local variables and loop labels introduced by a declarative definition resolve at definition site; captured identifiers retain caller context; expansions receive distinct syntax contexts.
Nonlocal item paths in expansion resolve at invocation site; unresolved invocation-site paths reject without fallback to definition-site items.
Dollar-crate resolves to the defining crate identity and does not bypass visibility; identifier matching cannot capture dollar-crate.
Unqualified macro names use textual scope: definition must precede invocation; nested definitions shadow until the enclosing scope exits; duplicate metavariable bindings reject.
